page.layout: Running head "NOTÆ." and page number 253 at the top. One text column, continuing from the previous page, with the Latin and Arabic text running in one paragraph. Marginal notes in a right-hand column: an Arabic note, "i.e. absque merito", and "Sharhol-Mawaket". Catchword "bona" below the last line.

main_text.p: injustitia sit ut quis res administrandas suscipiat, ubi jus non habeat, aut res in loco non suo ponat; at cùm ille rerum Dominus sit absolutus affingi non potest ei iniquitas, neque attribui ei injustitia. Et paulo post, واصل التكليف لم يكن واجبا علي الله تعالي ان لم يرجح النفع ولا اندفع به عنه ضرر وهو قادر علي مجازاة المبين[?] ثوابا وعقابا وقادر علي الافضال عليهم ابتداء تكرما وتفضلا والثواب والتفضل والنعيم واللطف كله منه فضل والعقاب والعذاب كله عدل لا يسأل عما يفعل وهم يسألون Fundamentum autem impositionis mandatorum non esse quid Deo necessarium, cùm nulla inde illi redeat utilitas, nec ullam ab eo pellaturلا استحقاق[?] hoc modo incommodam; & possit ipse homines remunerare vel præmio vel pœnâ, aut ergà illos gratiam exercere primò liberè & gratuitò quod ad præmium autem & gratuitam bonorum collationem & gaudium, & gratiami.e. absque merito. Sharhol-Mawaket[?], esse hæc omnia benignitatem; pœnam verò & cruciatum, justitiam, nec ab illo quari; Cur ita fecerit? ab illis au-tem quaeri. Sic Author Shatholt Tawalea[?]. Dicunt (inquit) noftri الثواب فضل من الله والعقاب عدل وفعل الطاعة دليل علي حصول الثواب وفعل المعصية علامة العقاب Obedientia autem [erga Deum] signum est præmii futuri, & transgressio, indicium pœnæ [executuræ.] Idem alibi الاعمال الصالحة امارات للسعادة والاعمال السيئات علامات للشقاوة Opera

page.notes: Arabic passages copied from the scan; several Arabic words are uncertain (the word after "مجازاة" and the Arabic note), so I have marked them with [?]. The Latin "Shatholt Tawalea" and the Arabic-transliterated "Sharhol-Mawaket" are doubtful. The catchword "bona" sits below the last line "Opera". The Arabic note in the margin is partly faded and its reading is uncertain.
